string.text: Crouch key crouches; former Walk/Low Crouch key goes prone; sprint stays sprint. Walk uses the MCM walk key only. Hold/Toggle and the three pose keys mirror into game Controls so they always match.
Intercept crouch and walk/low-crouch keys and map them directly to crouch and prone poses.
Sets crouch, walk, and sprint hold/toggle together. First load copies crouch's current setting, then forces all three to match.
These three binds write to Options - Controls (crouch / walk-low-crouch / sprint). Walk key is MCM-only.
Mirrors the game Crouch bind. Always enters crouch pose.
Mirrors the game Walk / Low Crouch bind. Always enters prone.
Only way to enter walk mode. MCM-only (not a game Controls row). Uses the Hold/Toggle mode above.
